Includes an offline library of 873 exercises with demos, streaks, achievements, and a shareable weekly recap. Private by design, local-first. Rebuilt from scratch in 2.0.

posts.name: Calcxi - Water Intake Calculator
posts.tagline: Calculate your precise daily water needs
posts.description: Calculate exactly how much water you should drink per day based on your weight, activity, climate, diet, and caffeine intake. Includes a personalized hourly drinking schedule, urine color checker, food water tracker, and today's intake tracker. Free — based on NIH & ACSM guidelines.

posts.description: Mobile Builds puts Xcode Cloud on your iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro. 2026.6 adds Siri, Shortcuts and Spotlight: ask what's building, find every failed run, or re-run a broken build by voice — without opening anything. Free, and private by default.

posts.tagline: A spiral for narrowing the gap between intention and reality
posts.description: The Way of Intentional Flow 🌌 — a spiral for narrowing the gap between intention and reality. Three pillars: WHAT — what already is, OWN — what's yours, NEED — what you gather. Not sharpening you into a tool — keeping a channel for you to grow more human than human. - Won-Cafe/W.O.N

posts.name: WishNote
posts.tagline: A calm place for your wishes, goals, and daily notes
posts.description: WishNote brings your wishes, goals, notes, reminders and checklists into one calm app, instead of juggling separate single-purpose apps. Available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, synced with iCloud.

posts.name: AI Fashion tech app - Production Build
posts.tagline: Launching our production builds, AI Fashion, Global distri.
posts.description: Most fashion apps are storefronts. Cheeky starts with your closet: snap your own clothes and it mixes them with new pieces, giving you recommendations that complete what you already own, not "people also bought." Talk to the AI voice stylist ("something for a rooftop dinner") and it builds the look in real time. Feeds learn your taste, sold-out items vanish, last-call pieces get flagged, and prices include taxes up front. Other apps make you scroll a mall. Cheeky builds one around your closet.

posts.name: Onomanabi
posts.tagline: Learn the feeling behind 1,500+ Japanese onomatopoeia
posts.description: Onomanabi helps Japanese learners move beyond dictionary definitions: 1,500+ words, each animated to show how it feels, plus similar-word comparisons, level-based lessons, quizzes, SRS review, and native-perspective notes. Try the first two levels free; a one-time purchase unlocks everything - no subscription - across iOS, Android, and Web.

posts.name: GetAtMe
posts.tagline: Find real people nearby — instantly.
posts.description: GetAtMe is a dating app built for people who are tired of dead matches, fake profiles, and conversations that go nowhere. I built it because modern dating apps feel like slot machines — endless swiping, zero connection, and no real momentum. GetAtMe flips the entire experience by making dating fast, real, and actually fun again. With GetAtMe, you get: • Instant matching with people who are actually active • Real profiles — no bots, no ghosting, trust engagement and no swiping

posts.name: Meetfy.ai
posts.tagline: The AI that helps while you're still in the meeting
posts.description: Meetfy is a live AI coach for real conversations. Most AI meeting tools tell you what happened. Meetfy.ai helps while it's happening. Tell Meetfy who you're meeting and your goals. During the conversation, it privately coaches you, reminds you what you've missed and warns you before sensitive topics come up. Perfect for teams: admins can access all meetings, summaries, tips and photos. Works for sales calls, negotiations, interviews, masterclasses and many more.

posts.name: Wittverse
posts.tagline: Autonomous AI Project Manager
posts.description: Wittverse is an autonomous AI project manager that connects directly to your development footprint. Background agents analyze live activity to automatically update timelines, predict potential risks, and resolve execution blockers.

posts.name: Saver App
posts.tagline: Tasks, bookmarks, and habits, together and in sync
posts.description: Saver brings bookmarks, to-dos, and habits into one simple, organized workspace. Save links, capture tasks, build routines, and keep everything easy to find without switching between tools. Create shared spaces for projects, trips, reading lists, or household plans, then collaborate in real time. Saver works offline, stays free forever on mobile, and has no ads anywhere. Everything stays synced across your devices, so your plans, ideas, and progress are always available whenever you need it all.

posts.name: OmniMend
posts.tagline: AI-guided PC repair with zero-day Security Vitals
posts.description: OmniMend helps people diagnose difficult Windows problems without guessing through generic fixes. Describe the issue in plain English, let it examine available device evidence, and review supported repairs before they run. Version 2.0.2 adds Security Vitals Beta for unfamiliar activity, including patterns linked to emerging and zero-day attacks. It works alongside Microsoft Defender or another registered antivirus, explains why an event deserves attention, and leaves the next step to you.

posts.name: OpsNest
posts.tagline: Application for project invoicing
posts.description: OpsNest is a Windows application for project invoicing, costs, payments and clear project profit in EUR.

posts.name: Crow - Data Analytics tool
posts.tagline: Your smart data analysis companion
posts.description: Most software makes you adapt your workflow to the software. Crow does the opposite. We customise the solution around your business needs, whether it’s finance, operations, Excel automation, reconciliation, or data analysis — giving you a solution that fits your work without the high cost of traditional platforms.

posts.name: Lys
posts.tagline: Agent-native iOS development, testing and deployment
posts.description: Most coding agents can write iOS code, but testing what they built is still awkward. I built Lys around that missing loop. Agents can use the simulator, test real flows and see runtime issues. TestFlight is built in too, so tester feedback, screenshots and device context can go straight to an agent to fix. I also built a testing SDK for Swift and Expo/React Native to make apps easier for agents to test reliably. Lys is free and open-source.

posts.name: Parsefy
posts.tagline: JSON, CSV and Excel converters that never upload your data
posts.description: Parsefy is a set of browser-only converters for JSON, CSV, Excel and markdown tables. Paste an API response or drop ajson file and get clean, spreadsheet-ready output — nested objects become dot-notation columns, and records with different keys merge into one header row instead of dropping fields. Nothing is uploaded. Everything runs in your own tab, so it's safe for production data and client exports. No account, no file-size limits, works offline.

posts.name: IOWNIT Early Adopter Program
posts.tagline: Join our exclusive ambassador network for coaches⁠
posts.description: OWNIT redefines coaching tech with real-time video analysis and smart tracking, turning raw movement into actionable data. Unlike traditional tools, our platform empowers coaches to deliver instant feedback, automate client tracking, and scale their business seamlessly. We bridge the gap between human expertise and automated performance insights to give your athletes a true competitive edge.

posts.name: OpsGraph
posts.tagline: Evidence-first agentic investigations for PostgreSQL
posts.description: OpsGraph is a self-hosted, public-validation alpha for evidence-first PostgreSQL investigations. A model may propose bounded read-only queries; OpsGraph enforces schema and table scope, timeouts, row limits, policy gates, source-owned evidence bindings, citations, and a local audit chain. Start with the bundled synthetic workspace. Use only synthetic data or non-production replicas for now.
